title: Labels for comparison phases
statement: For natural numbers $a$, $b$, and $f$, define a map from the two comparison labels to the instruction labels by sending the unary-block comparison label to the instruction that returns true, and the doubled-adjacency comparison label to the instruction that clears the auxiliary register in the matrix phase.
